description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de transformer la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses. Chez Deliveroo, impact, innovation et croissance sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les livreurs partenaires pour donner à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elle veut, comme elle le veut, quand elle le veut et où elle le veut.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Ce que vous ferez au quotidien

En tant que Account Associate - Retail & Grocery (H/F), vous serez responsable du succès d’un portefeuille de partenaires, afin d’assurer la meilleure expérience à nos utilisateurs, tout en construisant un partenariat solide et durable avec nos eux pour notre application.

  • Analysez la performance de votre portefeuille et prenez les mesures adéquates, faites des recommandations, soyez agile et ouvert à la nouveauté.

  • Optimisation et gestion de Processus : Deliveroo est une société qui évolue à grande vitesse et à grande échelle. Vous aurez l’opportunité de créer et améliorer des processus, par exemple la gestion de partenariats pour contribuer à la croissance. Vous élaborerez des documents de meilleures pratiques pour des comptes spécifiques et pour l'ensemble du portefeuille

  • Relations avec les magasins Retail et/ou Grocery : Vous gérerez le développement des partenariats, le suivi des données, et vous assurerez une expérience optimale sur l’application afin de faire de Deliveroo le service de livraison à domicile de référence, en apportant votre expertise Food Tech en étant l'expert de votre zone / ville.

  • Vous veillerez au suivi du respect des engagements contractuels pris avec les partenaires de votre portefeuille.

Ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir

  • Expérience : stage ou alternance dans un rôle d’Account management ou commercial. Une expérience terrain au sein d’un grand groupe (idéalement supermarché, marketplace, ecommerce, retailer, FMCG) est un vrai atout.

  • Commercial : vous avez à cœur de négocier, d’anticiper des discussions commerciales, d’entreprendre des actions afin de maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociations de mise en place d'outils commerciaux, etc)

  • Entrepreneur : vous avez le goût pour entreprendre, créer, aller chercher des opportunités, en sachant prendre de la hauteur mais sans jamais se couper du terrain et de votre téléphone pour comprendre vos partenaires.

  • Analytique : capable d’être synthétique, d'approfondir les données et de comprendre les données qui permettent d'améliorer les performances pour nos partenaires en magasins.

  • Proactif(-ive) dans vos relations avec les interlocuteurs. Vous adorez être sur le terrain et vous êtes impliqué(e) dans tout ce qui est opérationnel dans votre périmètre.

  • Centré sur le client : être obsédé par nos clients. Utiliser des données quantitatives et qualitatives pour construire un service qui soit opérationnellement excellent pour nos clients.

  • Jouer en équipe : un joueur d'équipe qui collabore et qui est capable de tirer le meilleur parti des personnes qui vous entourent. Capable de travailler efficacement à tous les niveaux de Deliveroo et de réussir avec et par les autres.

  • Optimiste, confiant et plein d'énergie : vous apportez de la fraîcheur, de l'énergie et de la passion dans l'équipe. Vous contribuez à créer un environnement de travail unique, propice aux nouvelles idées et agréable pour les autres personnes impliquées.

  • Langues : Français et Anglais courant indispensables.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Nous sommes des passionnés de food, des problem-solvers, des créateurs de communauté et bien plus encore. Ce qui nous rassemble : un esprit entrepreneurial fort et l’envie de construire quelque chose d’ambitieux ensemble.

🔧 Une grande autonomie pour avoir un impact concret sur votre portefeuille et nos partenaires.
🌱 Un environnement stimulant favorisant l’apprentissage, le développement et l’évolution de carrière.
💙 Des avantages pensés pour le bien-être et l’équilibre de nos équipes.
🌍 Une culture inclusive, internationale et collaborative où chacun peut trouver sa place.

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Prêt(e) à contribuer au futur de la foodtech ? Postulez dès aujourd’hui !

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment.  As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

WPP Media: Sports & Entertainment is our dedicated practice focused on the development of brand partnerships, sponsorships, branded entertainment and socially driven content solutions for brands. We work with the biggest and most impactful brands, platforms, IP, rights holders, talent and creators to drive our work.

We passionately believe that Sports and Entertainment make modern culture. Across sport, music, fashion, gaming and entertainment, they fuel the communities and fandoms that drive audiences and power brand differentiation. The vision of our 100+ dedicated craft experts is simple – We make brands epic in culture.  

The Associate Director, Creative Strategy is a senior role within WPP Media Sports & Entertainment. Reporting to the Director, Creative Strategy, you will sit at the intersection of human insight, cultural trends, and entertainment. Your primary mission is to turn brand objectives into culturally impactful ideas that deliver growth for our clients.

This role bridges strategic ambition and day-to-day execution. You will be confident navigating the entire process: taking complex client briefs, developing channel-agnostic creative strategies, leading idea development alongside creative teams, and guiding those ideas as they come to life.

As an important member of the team, you will take meaningful ownership of client relationships, actively contribute to organic growth, and mentor and manage junior strategists, acting as a trusted, day-to-day strategic partner for both internal specialist disciplines and external client teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Insight Generation

  • Lead the development of powerful, insight-driven creative strategies that inform clear creative territories for brands.
  • Uncover deep insights across consumer behavior, cultural shifts, and connection channels to unlock new opportunities.
  • Reframe a brand's role in the world—moving it from a product people buy to a cultural story they want to actively participate in.
  • Integrate Creative Strategy expertise seamlessly within the wider media Planning process.

  • Work closely with creative, partnership, and specialist teams to develop high-quality, channel-agnostic ideas that deliver cultural impact and commercial outcomes.
  • Create the optimal conditions for creative ideas to flourish, supporting teams as they bring concepts to life.
  • Connect client briefs to culturally relevant platforms, talent, rights holders, broadcasters, and creators.
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging cultural trends, social platforms, and technologies (e.g., WPP Open) to keep our strategic output cutting-edge.

Client & Account Leadership

  • Take senior day-to-day ownership of strategic accounts, building trusted, consultative relationships with key client contacts.
  • Act as a specialist advisor to clients, helping them navigate opportunities across sport, music, gaming, fashion, and entertainment.
  • Deliver compelling client presentations and pitches, articulating complex strategic narratives with ease and confidence.
  • Partner with Client Directors to identify opportunities for organic business growth, upselling, and expanded scopes of work.

Team Management & Upskilling

  • You will mentor, and support the wider department’s team members, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and career growth support.
  • Foster a collaborative, creative, and strategically rigorous team culture.
  • Upskill and train the wider agency team on core strategic competencies, such as insight generation, territory development, and brief writing.

Skills and Experience

  • Experience in creative strategy, brand planning, or partnership planning within an agency, media owner, sports, or entertainment business.
  • End-to-End Strategic Prowess: Proven experience taking a project from the initial client brief, through deep insight and strategic territory mapping, to creative execution.
  • Cultural Native: A deep understanding of and passion for the branded entertainment, sport, gaming, and cultural marketing landscape.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Strong collaborative skills to deliver multidisciplinary, integrated campaigns alongside diverse internal and external teams.
  • People Management: Experience managing or mentoring junior team members with a genuine commitment to helping others develop.
  • Communication & Storytelling: Exceptional client-facing skills, with a track record of presenting complex strategic concepts clearly and persuasively.
  • What Success Looks Like
  • Impactful Work: Your client portfolio consistently delivers highly innovative, channel-agnostic creative strategies that generate real cultural buzz.
  • Trusted Advisory: Clients value you as a vital, senior day-to-day strategic partner, resulting in strong retention and expanded scopes of work.
  • Team Growth: The junior strategists and executives under your guidance are visibly progressing in their strategic craft, confidence, and output.
  • Internal Leadership: You are recognised as a core driver of creative and strategic excellence within the WPP Media Sports & Entertainment network.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”

  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world

  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America

  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

We are seeking a visionary Regional Chief Strategic Architect to serve as Workato's technical authority and strategic advisor to our most critical prospects, customers, and the broader market within their assigned region. The Chief Strategic Architect operates at the nexus of technical credibility, executive influence, and market thought leadership, acting as the external-facing voice of Workato's innovation and technical vision.

This is not a sales role. It is a strategic, hybrid operator-advisor-influencer position. Chief Strategic Architects act as extensions of the executive team in the field, elevating conversations with senior leaders and positioning Workato as the essential platform for enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and intelligent automation.

This role is accountable for building technical trust across the customer lifecycle - from initial engagement through strategic expansion - while simultaneously shaping how the market understands enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and intelligent automation. The Chief Strategic Architect influences deal outcomes, product direction, and industry perception, ensuring Workato is recognized as the definitive leader in Enterprise Orchestration.

First 90 Days

Learn & Align (Days 0-30)

  • Deep immersion into Workato's AI vision, product roadmap, and GTM strategy

  • Shadow at least 10 executive customer conversations

  • Develop initial point of view for engagement with CIO/CTO/CDO personas

Engage & Formulate (Days 30-60)

  • Lead first strategic engagements with enterprise accounts

  • Co-develop executive playbooks with Sales and Product teams

  • Establish feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams

Influence & Scale (Days 60-90)

  • Cultivate trusted relationships with C-level executives in 5+ strategic accounts

  • Co-create first AI-driven integration use cases with customers

  • Establish thought leadership presence through content and speaking opportunities

Technical Trust & Executive Relationships

  • Engage directly with C-level executives (CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, Chief AI Officers) at enterprise accounts to shape integration strategies that solve complex business challenges

  • Serve as trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle - from initial engagement through expansion - providing strategic guidance rooted in real-world operator experience

  • Build lasting peer-to-peer relationships that position you as the go-to expert on enterprise integration, AI orchestration, and automation at scale

  • Act as technical closer in competitive deals, articulating why Workato's architecture differentiates us from competitors like MuleSoft and Boomi

  • Influence enterprise architecture decisions and multi-year technology strategies at the executive level

AI, Agentic Automation & Enterprise MCP Strategy

  • Shape and guide customers' AI and agentic automation journeys, leveraging Workato's AI capabilities and ecosystem

  • Advise on the design and adoption of agent-based workflows, human-in-the-loop models, and decision automation frameworks

  • Partner with customer executives to define enterprise MCP (Model Context Protocol) strategies including context management, secure AI orchestration, and governance

  • Translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable enterprise use cases that drive measurable business outcomes

  • Position Workato as the integration and orchestration backbone for enterprise AI transformation

Domain Expertise & Thought Leadership

  • Establish yourself as the recognized authority across iPaaS, API Management (APIM), data orchestration, EDI, and AI/Agentic automation

  • Lead "Art of the Possible" workshops that fundamentally shift how customers think about enterprise integration and intelligent automation

  • Represent Workato at industry conferences, customer advisory boards, analyst briefings, and partner events

  • Create high-impact thought leadership content: blogs, white papers, webinars, reference architectures, and technical videos

  • Shape industry narratives and best practices that establish Workato as the category leader

Deal Acceleration & Commercial Impact

  • Accelerate deal velocity through technical validation, competitive differentiation, and executive trust-building

  • Identify and shape strategic expansion opportunities by uncovering automation, integration, and AI-driven transformation initiatives

  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales Leadership on account strategy, competitive positioning, and C-level engagement tactics

  • Articulate compelling ROI narratives and business case frameworks that accelerate buying decisions

  • Demonstrate measurable impact on win rates, deal size, and sales cycle length in strategic opportunities

Strategic Advisory & Technical Leadership

  • Lead high-impact customer engagements requiring executive-level judgment, architectural vision, and industry expertise

  • Guide prospects and customers through Enterprise Orchestration vision and roadmap development

  • Develop prioritization frameworks for integration, automation, and AI use cases

  • Lead technology evaluation and vendor selection processes with enterprise customers

  • Design governance, scalability, and enterprise operating models for automation initiatives

Product Influence & Market Intelligence

  • Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering teams, channeling field insights into actionable roadmap input

  • Identify capability gaps, competitive threats, and market opportunities based on executive-level customer conversations

  • Develop and refine competitive positioning, objection handling, and differentiation strategies

  • Define reusable patterns, reference architectures, and technical frameworks that accelerate customer success

  • Influence industry analysts and thought leaders to strengthen Workato's market position

Internal Enablement & Team Development

  • Educate and enable Sales Engineers, Account Executives, and Customer Success teams on complex technical capabilities and emerging trends

  • Develop strategic frameworks, competitive positioning, and executive engagement playbooks for enterprise accounts

  • Mentor technical team members, helping them develop deeper domain expertise and executive engagement skills

  • Create scalable technical enablement content and programs that amplify your expertise across the field organization

  • Drive customer reference creation and participation in case studies, speaking opportunities, and advisory boards

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

  • 20+ years of technology transformation experience, including integration, middleware, or API management platforms

  • 15+ years in an Enterprise Architect, CTO, VP Engineering, or similar senior architecture/leadership role

  • Demonstrated experience advising C-level executives on technology strategy and enterprise transformation

  • Strong understanding of enterprise security, governance, and operating models

  • Proven track record of driving platform expansion and value realization in enterprise accounts

  • Excellent executive communication skills, including board-level presentations and strategic documentation

  • Ability to operate independently in complex, ambiguous environments and take ownership of outcomes

  • Travel to client sites up to 50%, with flexibility based on regional needs

Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or related field

  • Deep knowledge of key enterprise applications: Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle

  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, and GCP

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML platforms and agentic automation frameworks

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

  • Established personal brand and thought leadership presence in the integration/automation space

Measures of Success

Long-term success for this leader will be measured by their ability to:

  • Embed Workato at the heart of technology strategy conversations across the region's most influential enterprises

  • Cultivate sustained engagement with senior technology and engineering leaders ensuring Workato becomes synonymous with Enterprise Orchestration and AI orchestration

  • Create a robust pipeline of seven-figure opportunities tied to transformation initiatives

  • Reframe Workato in the minds of decision-makers and analysts as the essential platform for AI-enabled enterprise integration

  • Leave behind scalable playbooks and repeatable narratives that enable go-to-market teams to engage enterprise audiences with authority and credibility.

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

3071 - Commerce Account Director

About Wavemaker: A leading WPP Media brand

Grounded in analytics & insights and powered by data & technology, we believe in the power of media and creative to drive breakthroughs for the world’s best brands. We help clients understand the modern marketing paradox and discover the breakthroughs brands need to win with their consumers. We are designed for the new communications economy — built on data & technology, built for people & algorithms, built around diverse schools of thought, built to test & learn at scale, and, crucially, built to evolve.

Role Summary and impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Account Leadership & Delivery
    Lead the end-to-end output of the team across client-facing work and operational delivery. Ensure consistently high standards, with strong adherence to processes, controls, and best practices.
  • Strategic Planning & Business Understanding
    Develop a deep understanding of the client’s business, objectives, and KPIs. Apply this to shape effective, insight-led retail media strategies that drive measurable outcomes.
  • Retail Media Platform Expertise (Amazon, Citrus, Criteo)
    Demonstrate strong experience working across key retail media platforms including Amazon, CitrusAd, and Criteo. Apply platform expertise to guide planning, optimisation, and performance, ensuring best-in-class execution across search and display channels.
  • Tesco Retail Media SME Leadership
    Act as the subject matter expert for Tesco retail media, overseeing full-funnel activity and ensuring a cohesive approach from awareness through to conversion. Provide strategic guidance to both internal teams and clients on Tesco capabilities, opportunities, and best practices.
  • Innovation & Proactive Thinking
    Stay informed on industry trends, platform developments, and new product releases. Proactively identify and introduce opportunities to enhance client performance and maintain a competitive edge.
  • Client & Partner Relationship Management
    Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders and media partners. Act as a trusted point of contact, confidently contributing insights and recommendations beyond immediate scope.
  • Team Leadership & Development
    Support and develop a high-performing team, fostering a collaborative and accountable working environment. Take an active role in coaching, performance management, and career progression.
  • Communication Leadership
    Lead day-to-day communications across clients, partners, and internal stakeholders, ensuring clear alignment and effective delivery. Engage senior leadership when required.
  • Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
    Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency through better processes, automation, and adoption of tools and technology.
  • Financial & Process Ownership
    Oversee activation-related financial processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery across all campaigns.
  • Measurement & Performance
    Maintain a strong understanding of measurement frameworks and partner capabilities. Use this knowledge to guide optimisation strategies and performance discussions with clients.
  • Workshops & Strategic Contribution
    Lead and contribute to client workshops and planning sessions, bringing structured thinking, insight, and strategic direction.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration
    Work closely with cross-functional teams (including GOC) to ensure seamless integration and consistent, high-quality execution across all workstreams.
  • Retail Media Integration
    Play a key role in embedding retail media within broader client strategies, identifying opportunities to connect activity across the wider marketing mix, including audience planning in systems such as Sphere and Nectar 360.
  • Partner & Product Development
    Support the development and testing of commerce products and solutions in collaboration with partners such as Skai, ensuring continued innovation and relevance.
  • Personal Development
    Set clear objectives with your line manager and demonstrate ongoing growth in leadership, strategic thinking, and client impact.

 

Skills and Experience 

At WPP Media, our culture and people are at the heart of everything we do. In this role, it is essential to embody WPP and WPP Media’s core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by leading collectively to inspire transformational creativity.
  • Create an Open Environment by balancing people and client needs, cultivating trust and collaboration.
  • Lead Optimistically by championing growth and development to drive progress across the business.

 

  • Strong experience in eCommerce and retail media, including campaign set-up, management, optimisation, and reporting across both media owner and technology vendor platforms.
  • Excellent understanding of the strategic and tactical application of retail media and digital marketing, with the ability to translate this into effective client solutions.
  • Proven hands-on experience across key platforms, including Amazon, Criteo, and CitrusAd, with a solid understanding of the wider UK retail landscape (e.g. Tesco, Sainsbury’s, ASDA, Morrisons, Ocado) and quick commerce partners (e.g. Deliveroo, Uber Eats).
  • Experience working with bid management platforms such as Skai and/or Pacvue.
  • Experience with planning and activation across search/sponsored product and DSP.
  • Experience with AMC for audience and insight a bonus.
  • Demonstrated project management and team leadership experience, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver against deadlines.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience coordinating across clients, internal teams, and external partners.
  • High level of data literacy, with the ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and quality across all outputs.
  • Confident communication and storytelling skills, able to present ideas and strategies clearly and persuasively to a range of stakeholders.
  • Effective team management capabilities, including workload prioritisation, clear communication, and supporting team development.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with the ability to remain calm under pressure and navigate complex or fast-paced environments.
  • A genuine drive to elevate work beyond the expected, bringing energy, curiosity, and continuous improvement to the role.

 

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location 

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide. 

 

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

description: Die Position BERLIN · ab sofort · befristet bis 31.12.2027 Teilzeit – 32 Std./Woche | Besetzung vorbehaltlich der Mittelzusage Bewerbungsfrist: 30.09.2026, 13.00 Uhr Du möchtest gesellschaftlich relevante Themen verständlich, sensibel und zielgruppengerecht erzählen? Du hast ein Gespür für Social Media, Storytelling und politische Bildungsarbeit – und willst Inhalte und Kampagnen für ein antisemitismuskritisches Bildungsprojekt entwickeln, die junge Menschen erreichen? Dann werde Teil von GermanDream. Über uns GermanDream ist Deutschlands präsenteste Bildungsbewegung für gelebte Demokratie und Teilhabe. Mit unseren Begegnungsformaten, Bildungsprogrammen sowie durch Vernetzungs- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit vermitteln wir nachhaltig die Werte des Grundgesetzes – im Klassenzimmer, im Alltag und überall dort, wo Menschen zusammenkommen. Mit dem Projekt DECODED – Antisemitismus in Popkultur und Medien erweitern wir unsere antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit in Berlin. Gemeinsam mit jüdischen Künstler:innen, Expert:innen und weiteren Kooperationspartner:innen machen wir antisemitische Codes, Sprachbilder und digitale Dynamiken sichtbar. Wir stärken Jugendliche, Lehrkräfte und pädagogische Fachkräfte darin, Antisemitismus zu erkennen, einzuordnen und ihm handlungssicher zu begegnen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Workshops mit Jugendlichen, Qualifizierungen für Lehrkräfte, digitale Inhalte und weitere Formate. Deine Rolle Du koordinierst und gestaltest die kommunikative Umsetzung des Projekts – von der Redaktions- und Contentplanung bis zur Veröffentlichung: Du schreibst Texte, gestaltest Grafiken, konzipierst Videoformate, begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen, filmst selbst mit und schneidest kurze Videoformate. Dabei übersetzt du die fachlichen Themen des Projekts in verständliche, sensible und zielgruppengerechte Inhalte für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle – von Reels, Posts, Sharepics und Story-Formaten bis hin zu Website-Texten, Newsletter-Inhalten und begleitenden Kommunikationsmaterialien für Bildungsangebote und Veranstaltungen. Du entwickelst Formate und Kampagnen in enger Abstimmung mit deiner direkten Führungskraft, dem Projektteam und den eingebundenen Fachrollen. Du bereitest Einblicke aus der Projektarbeit redaktionell und visuell auf und behältst dabei Redaktionspläne, Termine, Abstimmungen und benötigte Materialien im Blick. So trägst du dazu bei, dass die Themen und Angebote des Projektes unterschiedliche Zielgruppen erreichen, jüdische Perspektiven respektvoll sichtbar werden und antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit auch im digitalen Raum Wirkung entfalten kann. Was dich in dieser Rolle erwartet Content, Redaktion und Storytelling Du planst, erstellst und veröffentlichst Inhalte für die Projektkommunikation für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und unsere Öffentlichkeitsarbeit. Du bereitest komplexe fachliche Inhalte verständlich, niedrigschwellig und zielgruppengerecht auf. Du gestaltest Texte, Posts, Kurzvideos und weitere digitale Formate rund um die Themen und Aktivitäten des Projekts. Du erzählst Geschichten aus Workshops, Qualifizierungen, Kooperationen und Veranstaltungen und machst die Menschen und Perspektiven hinter dem Projekt sichtbar. Du achtest darauf, dass jüdische Perspektiven respektvoll, differenziert und diskriminierungssensibel dargestellt werden. Du passt Inhalte an die jeweiligen Kanäle, Zielgruppen und Plattformlogiken an. Kampagnen, Social Media und Medienproduktion Du entwickelst und realisierst Kommunikationsformate, Contenstrecken und Kampagnen im Rahmen des Projektes. Du betreust die projektbezogenen Inhalte auf den Social-Media-Kanälen von GermanDream und sorgst für eine verlässliche Veröffentlichung. Du planst und begleitest Veranstaltungen, Videodrehs, Interviews und Videoporträts, breitest Fragen und Abläufe vor und stimmst dich dazu mit allen Beteiligten ab. Du begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen vor Ort, filmst selbst mit und sammelst geeignetes Foto-, Video- und O-Ton-Material. Du schneidest kurze Videoformate selbst und koordinierst weitere Kommunikationsmaßnahmen gemeinsam mit internen und externen Beteiligten. Du bereitest Inhalte, Materialien und Ergebnisse aus dem Projekt für unsere Kommunikationskanäle auf. Du unterstützt das Community Management auf unseren Kanälen, wertest Rückmeldungen aus und hältst vereinbarte Moderations- und Eskalationswege ein. Du greifst relevante Entwicklungen und Debatten in Popkultur, Medien und digitalen Räumen auf und entwickelst daraus passende Kommunikationsansätze. Zusammenarbeit, Planung und Auswertung Du arbeitest eng mit deiner direkten Führungskraft, dem Projektmanagement und den eingebundenen Fachrollen zusammen und stimmst fachlich sensible Inhalte eng mit ihnen ab. Du holst rechtzeitig Informationen, Materialien und Freigaben ein und sorgst für klare Absprachen und nächste Schritte. Du pflegst Redaktionspläne und behältst Veröffentlichungen, Termine und Produktionsabläufe im Blick. Du strukturierst und pflegst Content-, Foto- und Medienablagen, insbesondere in Notion und Teams. Du achtest auf einen konsistenten visuellen und sprachlichen Auftritt entlang der Brand Guidelines von GermanDream. Du wertest Reichweite, Resonanz und relevante Kennzahlen aus und leitest daraus Learnings für die weitere Kommunikation ab. Du bringst Erkenntnisse, Rückmeldungen und aktuelle Entwicklungen in die Weiterentwicklung von Inhalten, Formaten und Kampagnen ein. Du machst frühzeitig sichtbar, wenn Inhalte, Termine oder Produktionsabläufe angepasst werden müssen. Was du für die Rolle mitbringst Du hast erste bis mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Kommunikation, Social Media, Content Creation, Öffentlichkeitsarbeit oder einem vergleichbaren Arbeitsfeld. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Storytelling, Sprache, Bildwelten und digitale Formate. Du kannst gesellschaftspolitische und fachlich komplexe Themen verständlich und zielgruppengerecht aufbereiten. Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Erstellung von Content, insbesondere Text, Grafik und Video. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit gängigen Kreativtools wie Adobe Creative Cloud und CapCut oder arbeitest dich sehr schnell in neue Anwendungen ein. Du kennst Plattformen wie Instagram, TikTok, YouTube und LinkedIn und verstehst ihre unterschiedlichen Formate, Zielgruppen und Funktionsweisen. Du hast Erfahrung in der Planung, Begleitung oder Umsetzung von Videodrehs und Interviews und Social-Media-Produktionen. Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig und behältst auch bei parallelen Veröffentlichungen, Abstimmungen und Terminen den Überblick. Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Ansprechpersonen und arbeitest gerne im Team. Du interessierst dich für Antisemitismusprävention, Demokratiebildung und gesellschaftspolitische Debatten. Du gehst verantwortungsvoll mit jüdischen Perspektiven und diskriminierungssensiblen Inhalten um. Du wohnst in Berlin und bist bereit, regelmäßig für Drehs, Workshops, Veranstaltungen und weitere Projekttermine innerhalb Berlins unterwegs zu sein. Du arbeitest wertebasiert, inklusiv und diskriminierungssensibel. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Was dich bei uns erwartet Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn, gesellschaftlicher Relevanz und direktem Praxisbezug. Ein Projekt, das antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit mit Popkultur, Medien und digitalen Lebenswelten verbindet. Ein aufgeschlossenes, diverses Team mit Haltung und direkter Zusammenarbeit. Einblick in die Umsetzung und Steuerung eines geförderten Bildungsprojekts. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten. Anbindung an unser Team und Büro in Berlin-Mitte. 30 Urlaubstage bei einer 5-Tage-Woche sowie Heiligabend und Silvester frei. Ein monatlicher Benefit: Du kannst zwischen einem ÖPNV-Zuschuss oder einem steuerfreien Sachgutschein wählen. Dein Jahresgehalt liegt – je nach Erfahrung, Ausgestaltung der Rolle und individuellem Profil – zwischen 38.372,40€ und 46.899,60 € brutto bei 40 Stunden und wird entsprechend deines Stellenumfangs anteilig berechnet. Die Stelle ist bis zum 31.12.2027 befristet – die Besetzung erfolgt vorbehaltlich der finalen Mittelzusage für das Projekt. So kannst du dich bewerben Sende uns bis zum 30.09.2026, 13 Uhr über unsere Bewerbungsplattform: deinen Lebenslauf, eine kurze Motivation – als Text oder Video – und aussagekräftige Arbeitsproben, zum Beispiel aus den Bereichen Social Media, Text, Grafik, Video oder Kampagnen. Die Arbeitsproben sind ein verpflichtender Bestandteil deiner Bewerbung. Uns interessiert, wie du Inhalte entwickelst, Geschichten erzählst und gesellschaftlich relevante Themen für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen aufbereitest. Wir möchten ein Arbeitsumfeld schaffen, das von unterschiedlichen Perspektiven lebt. Deshalb freuen wir uns besonders über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Biografien und Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Herkunft, ethnischer oder sozialer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, geschlechtlicher Identität, sexueller Orientierung, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Alter oder Behinderung. Wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, aber das Gefühl hast, dass die Rolle gut zu dir passt, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Missions & Responsibilities

The Data Governance Director enforces global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets. He/She is responsible for transitioning data operations from manual checks to an automated Prevention–Monitoring–Correction framework. The rôle ensure strong data quality for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and ultimately WPP Open integrations.

As the Data Governance Director, you will enforce global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets. You will be responsible for transitioning data operations from manual checks to an automated Prevention–Monitoring–Correction framework. This role ensures strong data quality for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and ultimately WPP Open integrations.

1. Data Governance & Taxonomy Management

  • Framework & Model Ownership: Build, own, and execute the end-to-end Prevention–Monitoring–Correction data model.
  • Annual Taxonomy Review: Lead the yearly cycle for global taxonomy review, cleanup, and integration of new data dimensions across all Maisons.
  • Naming Conventions: Enforce standardized naming conventions globally, including unique Campaign IDs to enable automated campaign record aggregation via Accutics or internal systems.
  • AdTech & Tracking Governance: Oversee tracking standards across server-side tagging, GA4, channel grouping governance, and migration projects (e.g., BBB – ARM Migration).

2. Operations & Compliance Management

  • Data Accuracy Enforcer: Drive global data compliance from current baselines up to a strict 95% accuracy rate across all channels, Maisons, and markets.
  • Input Data Readiness: Ensure clean, trusted input data flows into Optimus dashboards (and ultimately WPP Open), eliminating fragmented taxonomies and reporting discrepancies.
  • Team & Process Oversight: Direct and advise Data Operations Executives and Associate Directors on best practices for automated data validation beyond basic string checking.

Qualifications & Profile

  • Experience: 8–10+ years of proven experience in Digital Data Governance, Taxonomy Management, or Media Data Operations.
  • Background: Strong AdOps background with hands-on experience in digital tracking, ad serving, and multi-market data compliance.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of taxonomy architecture, dynamic UTM/naming structures, Accutics, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), server-side tracking, and campaign management workflows.
  • Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of enforcing governance standards across multi-brand, multi-agency, and international team environments.
  • Key Soft Skills: Great autonomy, strong organizational skills, and a strategic mindset. High level of diplomacy, active listening, and the ability to communicate technical data governance standards clearly to both executive stakeholders and operational teams.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our commitment to shaping the future of media is reflected in active support for the professional development of our talent, helping them reach their full potential. This approach goes hand-in-hand with a responsible vision in our media investment strategies, reflecting our dual priority: valuing our people while adopting sustainable practices across our industry.

  • Social Impact: Opportunities to participate in community and solidarity missions via our "We care and we act" program.

Recruitment Process

  1. Recruiter Interview: An initial phone or video interview with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your experience, expectations, and answer your questions about the role and company.
  2. Operational Interview: An in-depth interview with key operational leadership to evaluate your technical background, leadership style, and cultural fit.

description:
About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

 

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

 

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

  • Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets
  • Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS
  • Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead an engineering team to ensure fast, high-quality execution. You will focus on rapid experimentation and technical excellence across the full customer lifecycle - from awareness and acquisition through to retention, revenue, and referral.

Operating at the intersection of engineering, product, and growth marketing, you will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate strategic visions into scalable engineering solutions. You will be responsible for empowering your team, optimising execution velocity, and maintaining high engineering standards as we scale our preventative care ecosystem globally.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure High-Quality Execution: Manage an engineering team or function to drive fast, reliable software delivery.
  • Resolve Technical & Operational Blockers: Act as an escalation point for complex technical and operational issues, solving them efficiently to keep projects on track.
  • Optimise Workloads: Balance priorities and take active responsibility for optimising team workload to maintain predictable delivery without burnout.
  • Drive Growth & Experimentation: Own the execution of sophisticated, data-driven experiments and growth initiatives across the entire patient journey.
  • Improve Engineering Processes: Continuously refine development processes, workflows, and team structures to build a high-velocity environment.
  • Build & Mentor Talent: Partner with talent acquisition teams to recruit, onboard, and retain world-class engineers while fostering a culture of ownership, psychological safety, and high morale.
  • Align Cross-Functionally : Partner seamlessly with Product, Marketing, and Data stakeholders to align technical delivery with commercial goals.

About You

  • Technical Strength & Codebase Ownership: You are technically strong and partner credibly with senior engineers-able to evaluate system architecture and spot when technical estimates lack substance. Coding is not the primary job, but you are comfortable getting on the tools in an ecosystem built on React, React Native, TypeScript, Go microservices, GraphQL, Kubernetes, and GCP, and delivering work to unblock your team.
  • Leadership Experience: Proven track record managing an engineering team to ensure fast and high-quality execution.
  • Operational Focus: Demonstrated capability in solving escalated issues, optimising team workloads, and driving continuous improvements across team workflows and structures.
  • Experimentation & Growth Mindset: Hands-on background or strong familiarity with rapid experimentation, A/B testing, and building software optimised for user engagement, conversion, and retention.
  • People-First Leadership: Skilled at mentoring engineers, navigating shifting priorities, and nurturing an inclusive, highly motivated team culture.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills with a history of bridging technical delivery with product strategy, growth marketing, and commercial outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in regulated sectors (such as healthtech, fintech or gaming), finding creative paths forward inside compliance constraints rather than being stopped by them.

Why join Eucalyptus

  • What's next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer, launching into new conditions, demographics and geographies.
  • Build something world-changing - We're on the path to becoming the world's largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced and deeply rewarding.
  • Make real impact - Your work directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.
  • Accelerate your growth - High ownership, continuous feedback and dedicated development support.
  • Join a motivated team - Talented peers solving complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What's ahead in the UK

  • Be an owner - Your own stake in the business with our employee options programme
  • Invest in your growth - Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave
  • Work flexibly - Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration
  • Support your well-being - Private health insurance through Vitality, or a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you
  • Take time off - 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks a year
  • Join a connected team - A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport and seasonal events

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The team Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all. European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it. The Role A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters. Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install — all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe. This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on. But the job is building and leading a team from day one — hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You shape this new team's charter and set the standard for how every future Mistral datacenter comes online. What You Will Do Build the delivery pipeline in Go: provisioning, configuration, validation, burn-in, network bring-up, software stack install. Build the team from scratch: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own their performance and growth paths — and set the tooling standards and the playbook every future site reuses. Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly — measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health — reliability starts at delivery. Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring. Partner with Product Managers and the datacenter org to plan delivery waves against capacity commitments. What We're Looking For You have automated bare-metal fleets — you have written the software that turns racks into clusters. If you have done it by hand, you resented it and scripted it. Hardware fluency: servers, GPUs, NICs, switches, firmware — you can read a parts list and a topology diagram. 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems, with at least 2 years leading engineers — real people leadership: you have hired, coached, and grown engineers, not just set technical direction. Deep Linux: you are comfortable well below the application layer. You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped. Willing to travel to datacenter sites when the work demands it. A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. description: TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm. About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The Role You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically. You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself. What you will be working on Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable. Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data. Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage. Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining. Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture. Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time. What We Are Looking For You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you. Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself. Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation. Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture. Nice to have Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD. Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data. Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap. Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning. Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data. GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization. Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules. Why Join Davis Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from. Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on. Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days. Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company. Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs. More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after: Team Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need. Why We Will Win Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites. Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable. This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application. Why be the Head of Data Engineering and Governance at THG? 

THG is building a world-class data function to power one of the UK's largest e-commerce businesses. As Head of Engineering & Governance, you will own the quality, availability and structure of the data that enables every business-facing team across our Beauty and Nutrition divisions.

This is not a systems infrastructure role. You are not managing foundational platform plumbing — that sits with our technology partner, Ingenuity. You will set the direction for how THG gets the most from its data ecosystem, ensuring that analytics teams, data scientists, and business leaders can trust and act on the data they see.

You will lead three distinct functions: Engineering (how we build, structure and maintain our data domains), Governance (how we ensure quality, consistency and trust), and Reporting (how we present business performance data consistently across PLC). You will work closely with Ingenuity, who provide the foundational platform and first-layer pipelines, to set requirements and standards that flow through from ingestion to insight.

We are at an early stage of this journey. Our data foundations need significant work — we have talented analysts who have been doing engineering work without the structure or tools to do it well, governance that is essentially non-existent, and reporting that has grown organically without consistency. You will shape and deliver the roadmap that fixes this.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Education & Background: Engineering degree (preferably in Computer Science) or equivalent experience.

  • Functional & Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of supply chain processes combined with proven experience on SAP modules (SD and MM).

  • Automation Mindset: Passion for eliminating manual repetitive tasks, tracking data performance, and integrating AI into daily operations.

  • Soft Skills: Team player spirit ("Play Collective"), clear communication, strong prioritization skills, and collaborative leadership.

  • Languages: Fluent English is mandatory (daily international scope).

TECH STACK

  • ERP / Systems: SAP ECC (SD & MM modules), S/4HANA roadmap.

  • Monitoring & Data: Operational control towers, ticketing systems, and custom monitoring dashboards.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Hybrid work organization (up to 2 days of remote work per week);

  • Equipment provided in line with your role and our sustainability commitments (Mac, Windows, or Chromebook);

  • A local project team within a global network (international career opportunities);

  • Continuous learning and development (technical certifications in year one, internal/external training programs);

  • Comprehensive compensation package (employee stock ownership scheme, monthly/quarterly bonuses).

We are a team of 5,000+ experts in software engineering, product management, data, cloud, and cybersecurity, distributed across Paris, Lille, and Amsterdam. description: Context: This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines’ RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (École Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources. Objective: To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size). Description: Task 1 – Model and inverse problem. Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations. Task 2 – Validation on the MAMBO database. The developments will be tested on an unducted propeller + stator configuration recently studied at LMFA (MAMBO project), instrumented with three arrays: a half-cylindrical array, a planar array on the side (representative of fuselage instrumentation) and a motorised arc array measuring directivity, which will serve as an independent reference. This study will assess the robustness of the method and define array design criteria. Task 3 – Application to flight tests. The methodology will be applied to the near-field pressure data acquired on the fuselage during the TAKE-OFF flight test campaigns, in order to identify the modal content of the noise radiated by the Open Fan engine and to infer information on its generation mechanisms. Starting date : 01/01/2027 Profile and application: PhD in acoustics, aeroacoustics or signal processing; skills in array methods, inverse problems and/or modal analysis; scientific programming (Python/Matlab). References: [1] Pereira, A. & Jacob, M.C., 2022, Modal analysis of in-duct fan broadband noise via an iterative Bayesian inverse approach, J. Sound Vib., doi:10.1016/j.jsv.2021.116633. [2] Roger, M. & Kucukcoskun, K., 2019, Near-and-far field modeling of advanced tail-rotor noise using source-mode expansions, J. Sound Vib., 453, 328-354. LMFA contacts: Antonio Pereira, Marc Jacob LVA contact: Quentin Leclère (LVA, INSA Lyon) Funding: European project TAKE-OFF (Technology and Knowledge for European Open Fan Flight) Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité. Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins. L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité. 🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’industrie du futur. Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ? 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que chercheur postdoctoal, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au centre SPIN. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez curiosité scientifique avec un intérêt pour l’articulation entre problématiques de recherche fondamentale et problématiques indus-trielles. Le centre SPIN est l’un des centres de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne dédié à la recherche en génie des procédés et rassemble environ 80 personnes comprenant enseignants-chercheurs, postdocs, doctorants, stagiaires, et profite du soutien de personnels administratifs et techniques. L’activité du centre SPIN s’inscrit dans le périmètre du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (UMR 5307) et du Laboratoire Environnement Ville et Société (UMR 5600). Vous développerez votre activité de recherche au sein du département « Procédés de Manipulation de la Matière Granulaire » (PMMG) qui concentre divers expertises scientifiques sur les procédés de transformation et la caractérisa-tion de matériaux granulaires à partir d’approches expérimentales et numériques, ainsi qu’à travers différents champs disciplinaires allant de la géométrie mathématique à la chimie minérale en pas-sant par la physique des écoulements complexes. L’activité du centre SPIN, comme du départe-ment PMMG, est caractérisée par une forte interdisciplinarité ainsi que par de nombreuses collabo-rations avec d’autres institutions de recherche et d’enseignement en Europe et dans le monde, et profite de nombreux contrats avec des partenaires industriels. La matière granulaire est un état de la matière particulier qui peine à être décrit par les lois de com-portement qui s’appliquent habituellement aux fluides, ou aux solides. Cependant une vaste majo-rité des matières premières transformées dans de nombreux secteurs industriels, ou des produits manufacturés, se présentent sous la forme de particules solides (grains de poudre, agglomérats, granulés, comprimés, etc..). La complexité de la dynamique de ces solides divisés émerge du grand nombre de particules solides concernées. En particulier dans le cas de particules solides transpor-tées dans une conduite de transport pneumatique, où l’écoulement d’un gaz le long d’une con-duite entraine les particules solides, les interactions avec les parois solides sont le siège de nom-breux procédés physico-chimiques. Au-delà des collisions élastiques qui entraînent le rebond de la majorité des particules solides sur les parois, des processus de fragmentation, d’arrachement de charges, d’échauffement local, etc. sont susceptibles de provoquer des transformations de la ma-tière transportée. Dans certains cas, la formation de dépôts sur les parois peut être observée et affecte négativement les performances du procédé de transport. Le travail attendu sera de mettre en place un montage expérimental capable d’étudier les proces-sus responsables de la formation de ces enrochements à partir de mesures de pression, de débit, de charges électrostatiques, d’observation par microscopie, de caractérisation granulométrique etc. Différentes poudres modèles pourront être utilisées afin de reproduire les observations d’enrochement reportées dans la litérature. L’équipe d’encadrement sera constituée d’enseignants-chercheurs du centre SPIN ainsi que d’ingénieurs R&D de notre partenaire industriel ORANO. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes titulaire d’un : • Doctorat en génie des procédés, physique des écoulements, en mécanique des milieux gra-nulaires, ou toute autre discipline scientifique qui présente un lien avec les outils utilisés dans l’étude des écoulements de grains. ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur Une expérience significative en publication et communication de résultats scientifique est at-tendue ainsi qu’une maitrise de la langue anglaise écrite et orale. 🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?
